option_relations.rationale: Small bowel ischemia due to mesenteric lymphoma is a specific type of lymphoma and bowel ischemia, which can be related to Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma and Bowel Ischemia due to Mesenteric Thrombosis or Embolism

Mesenteric lymphoma with bowel ischemia is a specific type of lymphoma and bowel ischemia, which can be related to Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma and Bowel Ischemia due to Mesenteric Thrombosis or Embolism
Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a specific type of lymphoma, which can be related to Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma

Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a broader class containing various types of lymphoma, including Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, Follicular Lymphoma, Mantle Cell Lymphoma, and Other Lymphoproliferative Disorders
